title: 第十章 师姐？！咋们是邪修？！
novel_title: 宗门收徒，我能看见属性词条
content_zh:
李应灵的冷冰冰的脸语配上她无情的话。

    厉行天默默回头看了李应灵，如果她的现在的盘子里不是啃了一半的兔头，或许自己也就羞愧难当了。

    但……

    不过厉行天还是开口解释道：“其实并非是在下不识好歹，只不过在下还有很多事情要做，没法长久呆在宗门。”

    “要不然早就答应前辈了，我也懂前辈并非看上我什么，而是也想救我一命才说收我为徒。”

    听着厉行天真诚的解释，楚星尘很是赞同的点了点头：

    “一般的宗门确实喜欢捆绑弟子。”

    说到一半，楚星尘话锋一转又悠悠道：“但我们天道盟不同，只要心系宗门，天涯海角都可去也。”

    闻言，厉行天看了看面前色香味俱全的兔子，毫不犹豫的动了筷子。

    前辈的潜台词他也不是听不懂，徒弟就徒弟吧。

    有恩必报也算厉行天的准则，如今或许拜师才是重生之后的真机缘呢？

    要还是个垃圾宗门，大不了就找机会再跑一次。

    浅浅入口，我草。

    才入口厉行天真觉得这兔子，是他吃过最好吃的兔子。

    果然越贵的兔子越好吃，厉行天总有一种吃个兔子把自己卖了的感觉。

    厉行天笑着夸赞道：“师父，别的不说您手艺真不错。”

    【收徒成功】

    【二徒弟：厉行天】

    【发放功法：混元魔骨炼体神诀】

    【请配合天魔道体使用】

    【完成任务一：奖励聚灵阵法】

    【所有奖励已放入系统背包】

    看到系统的结算页面，楚星尘十分满意的点了点头：

    “喜欢吃就多吃点。”

    厉行天恭谦道：“是，师父。”

    李应灵看着开始开始谦恭起来的厉行天，不由轻咳一声坐正姿态，勉励一般道：

    “作为师父第二名弟子，你得好好加油才行。”

    看见李应灵摆出的姿态，厉行天也懂这大师姐的想法，连忙拱手道：

    “好的，必然不会让大师姐失望。”

    李应灵脸上露出满意神色。

    新的小师弟还是很上道的嘛，以后就关照一下。

    毕竟只是出去一天时间就差点被打命都没了，想来就是个不太聪明的师弟。

    也不知道师父看上了哪一点，不过想想，也许真的是这个宗门太缺人了。

    不过李应灵头一回当师姐，而且还是大师姐的李应灵心中还是颇为激动。
content_en:
Li Yingling's cold face matched her ruthless words.

    Li Xingtian silently looked back at Li Yingling. If she didn't have a half-eaten rabbit head on her plate, maybe he would be ashamed.

    But...

    However, Li Xingtian still opened his mouth to explain: "Actually, it's not that I'm ungrateful, but I still have a lot of things to do, and I can't stay in the sect for a long time."

    "Otherwise, I would have agreed to it a long time ago, senior. I also understand that senior is not interested in me, but wants to save my life before accepting me as his disciple."

    Listening to Li Xingtian's sincere explanation, Chu Xingchen nodded in agreement:

    "General sects really like to tie up their disciples."

    Halfway through, Chu Xingchen changed the topic and said leisurely: "But our Tiandao Alliance is different. As long as your heart is with the sect, you can go to the ends of the world."

    Hearing this, Li Xingtian looked at the delicious and delicious rabbit in front of him and moved his chopsticks without hesitation.

    It's not like he doesn't understand the subtext of his seniors. An apprentice should be an apprentice.

    It is a rule of law to repay kindness. Now, maybe becoming a disciple is the real opportunity after rebirth?

    If it's still a rubbish sect, the worst it can do is find an opportunity to run away again.

    Shallow entrance, I'm fucked.

    Li Xingzhen thought this rabbit was the most delicious rabbit he had ever eaten.

    Sure enough, the more expensive the rabbit, the more delicious it is. Li Xingtian always felt as if he had sold himself after eating a rabbit.

    Li Xingtian smiled and praised: "Master, if nothing else, your craftsmanship is really good."

    [Successful recruitment of apprentices]

    [Second Disciple: Li Xingtian]

    [Distributing Kung Fu: Hunyuan Demonic Bone Body Refining Divine Technique]

    [Please use it in conjunction with Tianmo Dao Body]

    [Complete Mission 1: Reward Spirit Gathering Formation]

    [All rewards have been put into the system backpack]

    Seeing the settlement page of the system, Chu Xingchen nodded with great satisfaction:

    "If you like it, eat more."

    Li Xingtian said respectfully, "Yes, Master."

    Li Yingling looked at Li Xingtian, who was beginning to show humility, and couldn't help but cough slightly, sit upright, and said encouragingly:

    "As Master's second disciple, you have to work hard."

    Seeing Li Yingling's posture, Li Xingtian understood the senior sister's thoughts and quickly raised his hands and said:

    "Okay, I will definitely not disappoint Senior Sister."

    Li Yingling had a look of satisfaction on his face.

    The new junior brother is still very wise, I will take care of him from now on.

    After all, he was almost beaten to death after just being out for a day, so he was probably not a very smart junior brother.

    I don’t know what the master is interested in, but thinking about it, maybe this sect is really short of people.

    However, it was the first time that Li Yingling became a senior sister, and she was still a senior sister. Li Yingling was still quite excited.
title_en: Chapter 10 Senior sister? ! Why are we evil cultivators? !
